me.title: Me
me.description: Your launches, fees, holdings and trades on Base, Robinhood Chain and Arc.
me.heading: A space for your next move.
me.intro: Your launches, the fees they earn, and everything you trade. One wallet across Base, Robinhood Chain and Arc.

welcome.copy: Bring your launches, fees and trading activity into one view. No new account to create.
welcome.readOnly: Connecting lets you read. Transactions and edits need your signature.
welcome.manageCopy: Open each token, update its description, logo and links. On-chain settings stay fixed.
welcome.feesCopy: View your beneficiary share and uncollected fees. Collect to the recipients set at launch.
welcome.activityCopy: Check token balances and past trades across every chain, with links to the transactions.
welcome.disclosure: This dashboard reads public on-chain activity. There is no separate openlaunch account.

dashboard.loadErrorDetail: {error}. Your wallet and tokens are unchanged.
dashboard.refreshFailed: Refresh failed: {error}. Showing the last loaded data. Try Refresh again.

launches.title: Your launches
launches.description: Manage details and collect trading fees.
launches.emptyDescription: Tokens launched from this wallet will appear here, ready to manage.
launches.note: Edits change your description, logo and links. Name, symbol, fee and beneficiaries cannot change.

holdings.title: Your holdings
holdings.description: Current balances for tokens this wallet has traded here.
holdings.emptyDescription: After you trade a token, its balance and estimated value will appear in this view.
holdings.note: Values are estimates from the latest indexed price, not a guaranteed trade quote. Refresh to read balances again.

trades.title: Your trades
trades.description: The latest indexed buys and sells from this wallet.
trades.emptyDescription: Your buys and sells will be listed here, with a transaction link for every trade.
trades.caption: Your latest indexed trades on Base, Robinhood Chain and Arc

dashboard.disclosure: Viewing is read-only. Collecting fees asks for a transaction; editing details asks for a signature.

profile.description: {name} on {domain}: tokens launched and trades, straight from the chain.
profile.noteVerified: Every number here is read from the chain. The ✓ means this wallet posted a one-time code from that X account.
profile.noteUnverified: Every number here is read from the chain. No ✓: this profile has not verified an X account.

identity.checkingTitle: A person is checking your post. Your ✓ appears once it is approved.
identity.hiddenTitle: Your profile is hidden everywhere, and it can't be edited while it is.

profileSheet.postThis: Post this from @{handle}, then paste the link to your post. The post proves the account is yours; it does not earn anything by itself.
profileSheet.verified: Verified. The ✓ now shows next to your name.
profileSheet.review: X did not answer us right now, so a person will check your post. Your ✓ appears once it is approved.
profileSheet.intro: Your username shows next to your trades, posts and launches. Saving asks your wallet for a free signature, no transaction.
profileSheet.usernameHelp: 3–20 letters, numbers or _. You can change it once every 30 days.
profileSheet.name: Name
profileSheet.xWaiting: Your X claim is waiting: enter the handle again to keep it, or leave it empty to drop it.
profileSheet.xHelp: After saving you post a short code from this account. The handle stays hidden until it is verified.
profileSheet.deleteConfirm: Delete your profile? Your name, picture, bio and X tick disappear everywhere. A username you have had for a day or more stays reserved for this wallet for 30 days.

errors.hiddenByModerator: a moderator has hidden your profile, so it can't be changed right now
errors.couldNotFree: could not free that username, try again
errors.changedHands: that username just changed hands, try again
errors.signatureMismatch: signature does not match (with a smart wallet, switch it to Base and sign again)
errors.walletChain: your wallet lives on {chain}: switch your wallet to {chain} and sign again
errors.tooManyTries: too many tries, wait a bit
errors.checkFailed: could not check the post, try again
errors.codeNotOpen: that code is not open for this wallet; save your profile again for a new one
errors.pasteLink: paste the link to your post (x.com/you/status/…)
errors.codeUsed: that code was already used; save your profile again for a new one
errors.codeExpired: that code expired; save your profile again for a new one
errors.postNotFound: could not find that post; check the link (posts from private accounts cannot be read)
errors.privateAccount: that account is private; make the post public to verify
errors.authorUnknown: could not read who wrote that post; try again in a minute
errors.wrongAccount: that post is from @{handle}, but this code is for @{expected}
errors.codeMissing: the code {code} is not in that post

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Season points for creators whose tokens find real buyers and traders who find them early. Computed from the chain every hour.
leaderboard.soonCopy: Points for creators whose tokens find real buyers, and for traders who find them early. Computed from the chain every hour. Create your profile now and verify it with one post on X, from an X account at least {days} days old with {followers} or more followers, and your points count from day one.
leaderboard.intro: Real buyers and early finds, read from the chain every hour. Points are reputation: no cash value, not a token. <link>How points work</link>
leaderboard.endedWaiting: ended {date} · waiting for the final count
leaderboard.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {day left} other {days left}} · ends {date}
leaderboard.empty: No points yet this season. The board fills in as tokens find buyers.

steps.not_verified: Verify your profile with one post on X
